title: Unacademy Cofounders Plan ₹700 Cr AI, Deeptech Fund
script:
Unacademy cofounders Gaurav Munjal and Roman Saini are raising a seven hundred crore rupee venture fund.
The vehicle is called Longshot Capital and will back artificial intelligence and deeptech startups.
Roman Saini will run the new fund full-time while Gaurav Munjal remains at Unacademy.
The duo has already secured between two hundred fifty and three hundred crore rupees in commitments.
Would you pitch your deeptech startup to them?
